title: Serve European menu selection banks from extracted data
changes: Publish the 13 original menu tables and reader literals as a 728-byte resource in e380-d379. Bind all physical ranges at their original guest addresses, preserve the adjacent indexed-word owner and keep e379 attachable.
validation: Windows GNU u3uiazeh and Wine sjms_oc_ PASS. Original readers cross all 13 tables, all 32 source pointer reads and all 28 pair matches with altered backing. 2592 mixed and mirrored checks, complete state and clock, both invalid attachment guards, 180 previous resource hashes and the 182-file prepare, verify and reuse cycle pass. Wine drains, stage vjtb2m5a retains e380.
limitations: Uses controlled original reader entries. Ordinary menu triggers, live index domains, translated dispatch, Linux, USA and native Windows are pending.
